This doesn't happen if the mesh has some axes. So this works as expected:

```python
m = jax.sharding.Mesh(np.full((1,), jax.devices('cpu')[0]), axis_names=('x',))
sh = jax.sharding.NamedSharding(m, jax.sharding.PartitionSpec(), memory_kind='pinned_host')
a = jax.device_put(jnp.zeros([3, 3]), sh)
a[0]
```

That seems to be because the slice then doesn't entail any gather operation but instead goes via some other implementation.

### Description

## Steps to reproduce

Run in an interpreter:

```python
m = jax.sharding.Mesh(np.full((), jax.devices('cpu')[0]), axis_names=())
sh = jax.sharding.NamedSharding(m, jax.sharding.PartitionSpec(), memory_kind='pinned_host')
a = jax.device_put(jnp.zeros([3, 3]), sh)
a[0]
```

## Expected behaviour

One third of `a` is returned.
